learningGoals: To help your child identify and name the seven colours of the rainbow in a fun way. 🎨
To encourage imaginative thinking and creative expression through drawing and painting. 🖍️
To understand simple weather concepts like rain and the bright sunshine that follows. 🌦️
To develop reading comprehension and vocabulary through a beautiful story about nature. 📖
teachingTips: Read the story aloud with enthusiasm! Pause to ask your child what colour Anandi will use next. 🗣️
Point out different colours in your home and ask your child to match them with the colours of the rainbow. 🏡
Talk about the weather outside. Ask them what happens in the sky when the sun comes out right after the rain. 🌤️
Encourage them to draw their own dream garden just like Anandi did. Always praise their colourful creativity! 🌟

funActivities.title: VIBGYOR Sorting Fun 🔴🟠🟡
funActivities.description: Gather colourful toys, blocks, or clothes from around the house and help your child arrange them in the correct order of the rainbow colours. It is a fantastic memory and sorting game! 🧩

funActivities.title: Handprint Rainbow 🖐️🎨
funActivities.description: Use child-safe watercolours to paint your little one's hands in different colours and press them on a large white sheet to make a beautiful, messy rainbow. Hang it up on the fridge to make them proud! ✨

funActivities.title: Colourful Nature Walk 🌳🌻
funActivities.description: Take a short walk outside after it rains or early in the morning. Ask your child to spot and name different colours in the flowers, leaves, and the sky. Nature is the best classroom! 🦋
